parts.text: Hello. Briefly tell me what this workspace can do.
I can help through chat, create interactive dashboards, inspect workspace status, and coordinate registered A2A agents.
Give me a concise operational snapshot of this workspace.
The workspace is ready. Protocol health is 100%, there are no active runs, and the connected-agent count comes from the workspace snapshot.
